# spo_blocked_page_content_type (Resource)

Blocks creation of pages of a content type (Set/Get/Remove-SPOBlockedPageCreationContentType, CSOM). Keyed by content type: StandardPage, WikiPage, FormPage, ClientSidePage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_blocked_page_content_type" "wiki" {
  identity = "WikiPage" # StandardPage | WikiPage | FormPage | ClientSidePage
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String) The blocked content type (echoes identity).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
